{{Top|leg}}
A '''variable pressure adaptor''' was a component that could be used in [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref> and [[pocket computer]]s.<ref name="CRFG">[[Cracken's Rebel Field Guide (sourcebook)|''Cracken's Rebel Field Guide'']]</ref> On a blaster, it was a small adjustor on the [[XCiter/Legends|XCiter]] which controlled how much [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]] left the XCiter and entered the [[Actuating module/Legends|actuating module]]. A miscalibrated adaptor could result in too much blaster gas entering the actuating module which could cause overloads, misfires, and a loss of firepower over time. Variable pressure adjustors were part of a pocket computer's keypad. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] devised a way to use the adjustor to jury-rig a blaster into producing a targeting beam of light. By unplugging the [[trigger cable]] from the [[press plate]], a variable pressure adjustor could be plugged into the impulse slot and set between 0.106 and 1.0. The trigger cable was then plugged back into the adjustor. When the trigger was half squeezed, the [[Heter-Valve]] would release a small amount of gas into the XCiter. While the gas would be energized as normal, there was only enough energy to create a steady stream of light. The light was emitted from the [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]], creating a makeshift laser sight that pinpointed where a blaster shot would strike when the weapon was fired.<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
